# milvaion_worker (Data Source)

Read a registered worker, for example to check that it offers a job type before scheduling it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "milvaion_worker" "reporter" {
  worker_id = "reporter-worker"
}

resource "milvaion_job" "report" {
  name            = "nightly-report"
  worker_id       = data.milvaion_worker.reporter.worker_id
  job_name        = "ReportJob"
  cron_expression = "0 0 2 * * *"

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = contains(data.milvaion_worker.reporter.job_names, "ReportJob")
      error_message = "reporter-worker does not offer ReportJob."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `worker_id` (String) Worker id.

### Read-Only

- `current_jobs` (Number) Jobs running now across all instances.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `instance_count` (Number) Number of running instances.
- `job_names` (List of String) Job types the worker can run, sorted.
- `routing_patterns` (Map of String) Routing pattern per job type.
- `status` (String) Active, Inactive or Zombie.
- `version` (String) Worker version.
